# `compose_scroll`

Scroll a container to an item index. Identify the container by elementId, testTag, or text; omit all to use the first scrollable container.

  Container element ID, e.g. 'e2'.
- `testTag` — `String`
  Container testTag.
- `text` — `String`
  Container text, exact whole-text match.
- `index` — `Integer`
